owner: Core equation admission; Topic 0.10 reference verification
domain: periodic [0,2*pi)^2; continuum identities also require smooth fields

ontology.C: lane-specific relational/structural scalar; not identified with mass density
ontology.Phi: effective response scalar; not temperature, metric, or information
ontology.Q: proposed material response rate; distinct from Core Eulerian Pi
ontology.Pi: Core Eulerian rate reconstructed from Q and u; equals Q only when advective rate vanishes
ontology.u: new independent solenoidal fluid velocity, not scalar-gradient readout
ontology.rho0: separate constant reference inertia coefficient; not C
ontology.R_gen: derived trace only; no state or feedback edge

equations.source_mass: integral J_C dx=0 for the declared closed conserved scalar

derivation.scalar_functional: source-linked normalized Core constitutive functional; expanded formally from 1D to smooth 2D periodic fields
derivation.inertial_fluid_equation: constitutive_ansatz adopting standard incompressible momentum balance, not derived from UET action
derivation.advected_Phi_Q_pair: constitutive_ansatz requiring a new material-frame admission record
derivation.reversible_force: derived_relation from cancellation of advective functional work; uniqueness only up to a gradient and additional work-orthogonal terms
derivation.incompressibility: declared constraint, not derived from the scalar functional
derivation.units: normalized identities; formal SI dimension table is a proposal with no numeric UET coefficient/measurement calibration
derivation.zero_velocity_limit: At an instant u=0 gives Pi=Q. Parent Eulerian dynamics require u=0 and partial_t u=0 (frozen-flow algebraic control), not merely initially zero u; nonuniform scalar capillary force can start fluid motion.
derivation.dimensional_slice: SI table uses a 3D energy-per-volume dimensional target. A 2D slice integral is per unit out-of-plane length until a physical thickness is supplied; no joule claim.

coefficient_origin: Parent Core defaults for scalar controls; rho0=1 and eta=0.1 are declared synthetic reference controls, not He-4 or water parameters.

reference_verification.derivative: Fourier pseudospectral on resolved trigonometric controls; no timestep evolution
reference_verification.threshold_policy: Identity tolerances locked before first audit, unchanged after failure. Version 2 controls were amended after version 1 preview; not a blind preregistration or physical threshold.

manufactured_fields.note: All amplitudes and thresholds locked before first reference audit; no time integration.

next_action: Core review/admit the material-rate transform and independent momentum constitutive origin, or reject this candidate with a scoped no-go; then choose time-discrete J04 reference controls only for the admitted scope.

control_design_history.reason: Initial trigonometric streamfunction gave zero total reciprocal work by cancellation; missing-force and wrong-sign controls were insensitive. Thresholds unchanged. Control amendment follows observed preview and is not blind preregistration.
control_design_history.amendment: Add fixed mixed second harmonic 0.12*sin(2*x+y+0.31) to streamfunction, within resolved Fourier bandwidth.

auxiliary_symbols.mu_C: variational derivative of Omega with respect to C
auxiliary_symbols.mu_Phi: variational derivative with respect to Phi
auxiliary_symbols.p: pressure multiplier enforcing div u=0; zero mean gauge in reference
auxiliary_symbols.J_C: scalar source with zero integral in closed conserved lane
auxiliary_symbols.J_Phi: external response drive; its work is Q J_Phi/M_Phi
auxiliary_symbols.F_ext: external fluid force density; work is u dot F_ext
auxiliary_symbols.Omega: normalized scalar free-energy functional; no automatic SI energy meaning
auxiliary_symbols.E: normalized total reference functional including fluid and rate inertia
auxiliary_symbols.D: integrated nonnegative reference dissipation, distinct from tensor D_u
auxiliary_symbols.f: scalar free-energy density, including gradient terms
auxiliary_symbols.f_rev: reciprocal force density determined conditionally from advective work
